Exchanges.Text:
Hi Gate team-c, great to see you all.  

Our sprint goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 6 days left in the sprint.
Daniel, give us what you’ve finished, what’s next, and whether anything is blocking you. Also, are the earlier commitments for story 3, story 4, and task 15 each completed?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I have noted your commitment: Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Daniel, who can help unblock this? The blocker is the idempotency keys being in, so you can resume the summary page as soon as they’re in.
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.
Got it, Daniel. Noted, and I'm handing the floor back.
Maya, it’s your turn now. Please share what you’ve finished, what’s next, and if anything’s blocking you.

Maya, have the PCI scan exceptions waiting on the security review for story 5 been resolved, and have you finished pairing on bug 12 for the staging access?  
What did you complete, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Alright, quick interruption to keep us on track.
Let’s take that offline, and I will add it to the parking lot. Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Thanks, Maya. Noted that everything’s covered. I’ll hand the floor back now.
Thanks, Maya. I’ll invite Admin to give an update.

Thanks, Maya.  

Admin, did you finish your earlier commitment about task 14? Also, what’s next, and is anything blocking you right now?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.
Admin, noted: yesterday you finished the refund API tests, today you’re working on the payment retry story, and there are no blockers.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Team, we’re generally on track. Maya is blocked on bug 12 and needs access to the platform team staging gateway before continuing the summary page. Daniel is waiting on idempotency keys, and the side discussion about gateway timeouts will be handled offline. Follow-ups will be coming in Teams for task 19, task 15, and story 5. Thanks everyone.
